about: Freelance business engine defaults. Hours assume AI-assisted delivery (Claude Code / Codex) with your review and independent QA. Your own overrides live in data/business_config.json (not committed). Prices are configurable starting points for a new profile without marketplace reviews, set below 2026 market medians (roughly USD 40-100/hour for n8n and Python work) on purpose; raise them as real reviews and repeat clients arrive.
